timeline.summary: Niraj Bajaj, Promoter of Bajaj Finance Ltd., declared no encumbrance on shares held during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regn 31(4).
Bajaj Finance Limited’s Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹6 per equity share (including ₹0.60 special payout) on April 29, 2026, creditable on or about August 3, 2026.
On 29 April 2026, Bajaj Finance's board approved increasing the overall borrowing limit under Section 180(1)(c) from ₹375,000 crore to ₹550,000 crore, subject to shareholder approval.
Bajaj Finance reported Q4 FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹5,660 crore on an AUM of ₹509,975 crore.
Bajaj Finance reported Q4 FY26 consolidated AUM crossing ₹5 lakh crore to ₹510,000 crore and guided for 20-24% AUM growth in FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹24,546.37 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹6,266.2 Cr (+28.5% YoY).
Bajaj Finance reported Q2FY27 consolidated AUM of ₹584,624 crore and net profit of ₹6,367 crore, alongside a ₹17,500 crore fundraise plan.
Bajaj Finance raised FY27 AUM growth guidance to 26-27% on its Q2 call, citing strong momentum and an upcoming ₹17,500 Cr capital raise.
